title: LaserCube content — 50 scenes (MOXIR)
intro_html:
The six cubes, per scene (2026-10-15).

Not yet seen on a cube or in the room: a design and its checks. Six LaserCube Ultra MK2 on the back crane girder (8.81 m), six lines each (the 36-line comb). The two UP-LA40WF 40 W wait for their DMX charts. Data: each scene's laser field; frames: di.iiii scripts/place/laser_frames.py; full report: agent-reports-2026-10-15/moxir-50/laser-content-report.md.
notes_html:
• Patterns named from beam-show practice (Pangolin BEYOND effects: fan, beam sweep, tunnel, liquid sky; the comb/net is the rig's v2.8 MATRIX).
  • The 10-14 jam: one cube lit from di (a circle) — the only real-cube proof so far.
  • Safety: IEC 60825-1 and ILDA audience-scanning guidance — no beam ever goes below the cubes (8.81 m); the desk cap 0.16; the engine's fail-safes (200 ms frame timeout, still-beam guard). Plan legend: grey bay = the 24 m bay, blue band = lantern glazing (no ray may end there), grey bars = cranes, black dots = cubes in the group.
